title: rosa arvensis var. prostrata
intro: Rosa arvensis var. prostrata, commonly known as the field rose or wild rose, is a low-growing, spreading shrub native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rosa arvensis var. prostrata include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic agent, making it a useful remedy for urinary issues and skin conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
